name: EPIC 247585827
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 9.9 solar radii and 2.12 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247585827 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.919376 (16th-84th percentiles 9.568649-10.230846), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,739 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 2.12 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,991 K at its surface.
